UNCONTESTED CALENDAR OF NOV-15-2018, NOTICE OF DEFAULT JUDGMENT PROVE-UP HEARING AS TO DEFENDANTS - GRANTED. PROPOSED JUDGMENT WAS SUBMITTED TO AND SIGNED BY THE COURT. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY MITCH L. LYON, CSR #6840. TELEPHONE: 415-551-3703. JUDGE: ERIC R. FLEMING. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST, A CALIFORNIA BANKING CORPORATION DOING BUSINESS THROUGH ITS DITCH WITCH DIVISION RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DIRECTIONAL BORING OF THE CAROLINAS LLC, A NORTH CAROLINA LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY FRAMMARTINO, MICHAEL AN INDIVIDUAL $114,660.80 PRINCIPAL, $2,825.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $664.94 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $118,150.74, SEE SCANNED DOC - ADDITIONALLY, PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST, A CALIFORNIA BANKING CORPORATION, DOING BUSINESS THROUGH ITS DITCH WITCH DIVISION, IS TO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANTS DIRECTIONAL BORING OF THE CAROLINAS LLC, A NORTH CAROLINA LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY AND MICHAEL FRAMMARTINO, AN INDIVIDUAL, POSSESSION OF THE PERSONAL PROPERTY DESCRIBED ON ATTACHMENT 1 OF THE JUDGMENT. IF PLAINTIFF OBTAINS POSSESSION OF THE DESCRIBED PROPERTY AND SELLS IT A SALE, PLAINTIFF SHALL APPLY THE PROCEEDS FROM ANY SUCH SALE, NET OF ANY SALE AND RECOVERY EXPENSES, TO REDUCE THE AMOUNT OWED BY DEFENDANTS DIRECTIONAL BORING OF THE CAROLINAS LLC, A NORTH CAROLINA LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY AND MICHAEL FRAMMARTINO, AN INDIVIDUAL, UNDER THIS JUDGMENT.
CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE OF DEC-05-2018 IS OFF CALENDAR. JUDGMENT ON FILE. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
